pins.head: EVERYTHING ON THE MAT
pins.title: Epoxy Resin Tips: Set Up the Bench Before You Mix
pins.desc: Epoxy resin tips usually start at the pour, but the bench decides how the pour goes. Lay a silicone mat so drips peel off instead of soaking in, keep gloves and tape within reach, and stand the stir sticks in a jar so you are not hunting for one while the clock runs. Mixed resin gives you minutes, not hours, so everything should already be on the mat. Contains affiliate links. #ResinArt #EpoxyResin #CraftRoom
pins.alt: A black silicone mat on a dark wood bench holding a clear cup of amber resin, a glass jar of wooden stir sticks, a blue tape roll, an open box of blue gloves and a folded paper towel with a stir stick on it.

pins.head: THE MOLD PEELS BACK
pins.kicker: Get it out in one piece
pins.title: Resin Art for Beginners: Get a Piece Out of the Mold Clean
pins.desc: Resin art for beginners goes wrong at the last step more often than the first. Peel the silicone back from the edge instead of pulling the piece out, and a fully cured coaster drops free without a chipped rim. Wipe the mold while it is still clean, store it flat, and the next pour comes out just as glossy. Contains affiliate links. #ResinCrafts #SiliconeMolds #DIYCoasters
pins.alt: A clear silicone mold peeled halfway back from a glossy amber resin coaster on a pale oak table, beside a stack of empty round molds, a folded grey cloth and an amber spray bottle.

pins.head: SLEEP ONE SIDE, SIT THE OTHER
pins.title: Studio Apartment Layout: Let a Shelf Divide the Room
pins.desc: A studio apartment layout works once each corner has one job. An open-backed cube shelf turned sideways splits sleeping from sitting without blocking the window, and a rug that stops exactly where the shelf begins makes the boundary read as deliberate rather than accidental. Keep the shelf low enough to see over and the room still feels like one space. Contains affiliate links. #StudioApartment #SmallSpaceLiving #ApartmentIdeas
pins.alt: A bright studio seen from the doorway: a low oak cube shelf standing sideways between a cream sofa with a rust throw and a bed with grey linen, a jute rug on the floor and a tall fig in a woven basket by the window.

pins.head: MATCH TYPE TO SURFACE
pins.title: Permanent vs Removable Vinyl: Match the Type to the Surface
pins.desc: Permanent vs removable vinyl is a question about the surface, not about the design. Permanent adhesive is what you want on a mug or a tumbler that will be washed again and again; removable lifts off a painted wall or a rented window without taking the finish with it. Buy one roll of each before you buy a bundle of colors. Contains affiliate links. #CricutProjects #VinylCrafts #DIYDecals
pins.alt: A teal vinyl roll and a cream vinyl roll standing upright on a pale birch table in front of a green cutting mat holding a weeded grey leaf decal, with a grey felt squeegee and a pink weeding hook in front.

pins.head: TUBES BEAT TINY POTS
pins.sub: A Starter Set of Acrylic Tubes
pins.title: Acrylic Painting for Beginners: A Tube Set That Covers the Basics
pins.desc: Acrylic painting for beginners is easier with tubes than with tiny pots. You squeeze out only what you need, the cap keeps the rest from skinning over, and a wide color range means less mixing while you are still learning what mixes well. Keep a palette and a jar of water beside them, and rinse the brushes before the paint sets. Contains affiliate links. #AcrylicPainting #PaintingForBeginners #ArtSupplies
pins.alt: Plain aluminium paint tubes in assorted colors fanned across a dark charcoal desk mat, with a white palette holding teal, yellow and magenta dabs, two wooden-handled brushes and a glass jar of water.

pins.head: HANG SHELVES IN IT
pins.title: Small Closet Organization: Hang Shelves Inside a Rental Closet
pins.desc: Small closet organization in a rental has to work without a drill. A fabric shelf organizer hangs straight off the rail that is already there and turns a stretch of hanging space into folded storage for knitwear, clear boxes keep shoes visible on the floor, and a woven bin handles the top shelf. All of it lifts out again on moving day. Contains affiliate links. #ClosetOrganization #RenterFriendly #SmallBedroom
pins.alt: An open narrow closet with a fabric hanging shelf organizer of folded knitwear beside a rail of cream and sage shirts, clear lidded shoe boxes on the floor and a woven bin on the top shelf.
